RID-KU 004.label: อบต.เนินสว่าง

api._help: Set enabled to true and fill in each url. {station} = the gage's station (or apiStation), {from}/{to} = YYYY-MM-DD, {fromT}/{toT} = YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, local time. The reply may be CSV or JSON rows; columns are found as in the telemetry CSV files (datetime or date + time; 'rainfall from 7am' or Q). Optional per kind: jsonPath (e.g. data.items), column (regex for the value column), cumulative (true/false). The server must allow cross-origin requests (CORS) from the page's site, and keys placed here are public.
